title: How a Landlord Convinced Wall Street It Was a $47B Tech Miracle
description:
On January 8th, 2019, an office rental company in New York was valued at $47 billion—more than FedEx, Ford, and eBay combined.

Thirty-three days later, its bankers realized the company was 30 days away from hitting zero. This is the forensic, step-by-step story of how WeWork disguised an ancient, low-margin landlord business as a software revolution, invented fake accounting math, and triggered the fastest corporate collapse in modern history.
